title: Enrolments into Day Activity Centres and Plans to Cope with Increased Demand
what_it_is: Enrolments into Day Activity Centres and Plans to Cope with Increased Demand

sections.label: Day Activity Centre enrolment demand
sections.summary: MSF says eight DACs have no vacancies, increased funding by 20%, and is studying longer-term demand and new DACs.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of  Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling –  16 To ask the Minister for Social and Family Development with regard to enrolment into Day Activity Centres (DACs) (a) whether DACs can cope with the demand in the next five years; and (b) if not, whether there are plans to (i) reduce the average waiting time for enrolment and (ii) increase the staff support in this sector.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There are, currently, eight DACs with no vacancies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: When individuals apply to DACs with no vacancies, SG Enable will refer the caregivers to other DACs with spare capacity.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In October last year, MSF increased funding for DACs by some 20%, or $3 million per year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The increased funding will allow our DACs to hire more care staff to increase their quality of care and service standards, especially for clients with higher support needs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We are also studying the longer-term demand for DACs and will look into setting up new DACs in areas where demand is expected to exceed the current supply.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF will continually monitor and review our funding support and programmes to meet the needs of persons with disabilities and their caregivers.
